source.title: New WRT Leader (October 2021)
source.content:
We are happy to announce that we have a new WCA Results Team (WRT) Leader, Sébastien Auroux. Sébastien’s term had already been extended previously but as noted on the rights and duties of WCA Committees & Teams available in [WCA Motion 10.2021.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf), a new appointment had to be made.

Sébastien was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote among the current Committee Leaders and Senior Delegates, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams.

Other than Sébastien, the following individuals also applied:

* Brandon Reichman


You can find both of their candidacy documents [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q-f6JTcvXtEuQQSRMN7_Ee6k2cP7pBxk?usp=sharing). We thank Brandon for the application and wish Sébastien luck with his continued work with the team.

translation.title: WCA 成绩组负责人任命（2021 年 10 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴宣布，Sébastien Auroux 获任 WCA 成绩组（WRT）负责人。Sébastien 的任期此前已延长过，但根据 [WCA 决议 10.2021.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)中关于委员会与团队权利和职责的规定，须重新进行任命。

根据关于 WCA 委员会与团队的[决议](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4 节，WCA 董事会选定 Sébastien，并经现任委员会负责人及高级代表投票通过。

除 Sébastien 外，以下人员也提交了申请：

* Brandon Reichman

两人的申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q-f6JTcvXtEuQQSRMN7_Ee6k2cP7pBxk?usp=sharing)查看。感谢 Brandon 提交申请，也祝 Sébastien 继续带领团队顺利开展工作。
